scenes.conflict: Neighbors in the bunk-tunnels begin humming in unison, and his fear of confrontation makes concealment harder.
scenes.goal: Tomas wants to hide the shared song in his dreams from his supervisors and protect his family.
scenes.outcome: Tomas realizes the dreams are spreading, and he decides to secretly warn Nadia Okafor.
scenes.summary: In the cramped warrens, Tomas notices workers moving and speaking in unison. He hides his own dreams and resolves to warn Containment.
scenes.title: Shared Dreams

scenes.conflict: Voss dismisses Lena's fears while the Matriarch's song unsettles her and workers gather at the Pen walls.
scenes.goal: Lena wants to keep the Matriarch calm and understand what her song is saying.
scenes.outcome: Voss insists the Matriarch is safe and orders the findings kept quiet, deepening Lena's doubts.
scenes.summary: Lena reports that the Matriarch's song is changing. Voss, protective of her creation, downplays the danger and demands secrecy.
scenes.title: The Song at the Pen

scenes.conflict: Refinery workers are slowing down and humming in unison, threatening his quarterly targets and his career.
scenes.goal: Holm wants to keep enzyme output on schedule despite the reports of strange behavior among workers.
scenes.outcome: Holm orders the Matriarch's glands harvested at full rate and invokes shareholder rules to override objections.
scenes.summary: Holm sees production dropping and privately suppresses his doubt about the workers. He orders harvest rates raised.
scenes.title: Output Before Safety

scenes.conflict: Voss demands the Matriarch be preserved, Holm demands she be harvested, and Tomas's warning shows Okafor the contagion is real.
scenes.goal: Okafor wants authorization to seal infected sections and evacuate the uninfected.
scenes.outcome: No agreement is reached; each head sets a private plan against the others and the deadline begins.
scenes.summary: Okafor convenes the heads after Tomas's warning. Each head presses a different course, and the meeting breaks with all three scheming.
scenes.title: Three Heads, Three Agendas

scenes.conflict: Sealing traps thousands of workers, including Tomas's family, who may still be people.
scenes.goal: Okafor wants to seal the worst-infected tunnels to stop the contagion spreading through shared water and air.
scenes.outcome: Okafor seals part of the warrens in secret, and the Chorus begins testing the seals.
scenes.summary: Okafor seals tunnels over Tomas's pleas. He realizes she may treat his family as acceptable losses.
scenes.title: First Seals

scenes.conflict: Lena reveals she can't tell whether she hears the Matriarch or is infected, and Voss refuses to see the risk.
scenes.goal: Voss wants to design an enzymatic countermeasure that halts the contagion without killing the Matriarch.
scenes.outcome: Voss begins a countermeasure using Lena's observations of the song patterns, but Lena starts to doubt her mentor.
scenes.summary: Voss works in the vat benches using Lena's recordings of the song. Lena confronts her mentor's obsession.
scenes.title: A Biochemical Gamble

scenes.conflict: His workers fall silent and move as one, and Okafor's surveillance exposes his order to sacrifice workers.
scenes.goal: Holm wants to keep the refinery running and to stop Okafor from sealing the Enzyme Works.
scenes.outcome: The Chorus takes the refinery crews, Holm loses his labor force, and Okafor holds proof of his orders.
scenes.summary: The refinery crews join the Chorus mid-shift. Okafor arrives with surveillance evidence as Holm is left alone with his tablet.
scenes.title: Losing the Workforce

scenes.conflict: Holm invokes shareholder-protection rules to strip Voss's access while the Chorus gathers at the Pen walls.
scenes.goal: Holm wants to harvest the Matriarch's glands now, and Voss wants to stop him.
scenes.outcome: Lena sabotages the harvest to protect the Matriarch, and the Chorus presses harder against the membrane.
scenes.summary: Holm's team arrives to harvest the Matriarch. Lena blocks them as the Chorus closes in.
scenes.title: Locked Out of the Pen

scenes.conflict: Tomas brings word that individuals can retain themselves in the Chorus, forcing Okafor to rethink the quarantine as Holm and Voss continue to scheme.
scenes.goal: Okafor wants a joint plan before the tether link and the contagion force the decision.
scenes.outcome: Okafor shifts toward a risky compromise, Voss admits her countermeasure needs the Matriarch's cooperation, and Holm walks out.
scenes.summary: Tomas carries a message from the Chorus. Okafor, Voss and Holm clash again, and Okafor starts to bend.
scenes.title: The Deadline

scenes.conflict: Voss must choose between her creation and the workers, and a breach would flood the section within minutes.
scenes.goal: Voss and Okafor want to reach the Matriarch and stop the contagion before the Chorus breaks the Pen walls.
scenes.outcome: Voss accepts the Matriarch cannot be saved intact and prepares the countermeasure with Lena's help.
scenes.summary: Okafor, Voss, Lena and Tomas meet at the Pen as the Chorus presses on the walls. Voss finally chooses the colony over her legacy.
scenes.title: At the Membrane

scenes.conflict: Holm controls the harvesting systems that feed the Pen and refuses to give up the asset.
scenes.goal: Holm wants to harvest the glands one last time, and Okafor wants to stop him from blocking the countermeasure.
scenes.outcome: Holm sees the Chorus workers as lives he is liable for and yields control of the harvesting systems.
scenes.summary: Okafor confronts Holm in his empty refinery. Facing the silent workers, Holm finally yields.
scenes.title: The Ledger Cannot Measure

scenes.conflict: The treatment will end the Matriarch's sentience, Lena is torn between the creature and the evidence, and the Chorus resists.
scenes.goal: Voss wants to deliver the countermeasure through the Pen waters to halt the contagion while sparing as many lives as possible.
scenes.outcome: The countermeasure is released, the Matriarch's song fades, and the workers wake with their individuality intact.
scenes.summary: Lena and Voss release the countermeasure. The Matriarch falls silent as the Chorus breaks apart.
scenes.title: The Last Song

scenes.conflict: Okafor must decide whether to lift the seals when survivors may still carry the contagion.
scenes.goal: Tomas wants to find his family and learn who survived the countermeasure.
scenes.outcome: Okafor lifts the seals under supervision and Tomas is reunited with his family.
scenes.summary: Workers wake confused. Okafor opens the seals and Tomas finds his family alive.
scenes.title: Waking in the Warrens

scenes.conflict: Holm tries to protect his career and backers' returns while Voss faces the cost of her creation.
scenes.goal: Okafor wants to record what happened and settle accountability before the tether link brings an audit.
scenes.outcome: Okafor presents the surveillance record, Holm is exposed, and Voss accepts responsibility.
scenes.summary: The three heads face one another with the evidence. Each accepts a measure of blame for the toll.
scenes.title: Reckoning in the Ring

scenes.conflict: The patents that kept Voss funded for twenty years tempt her, while Lena questions whether the work should continue.
scenes.goal: Voss and Lena want to decide what to do with the genetic line that produced the Matriarch.
scenes.outcome: Voss and Lena choose to restrict the line, and they wait for the tether link to carry their account to the surface.
scenes.summary: In the Vat Halls, mentor and apprentice weigh the legacy of the Matriarch and decide how it ends.
scenes.title: A Quieter Deep

logline: When the Matriarch's contagious sentience turns Mariana Six's workers into a hive mind, three rival department heads must decide whether to save the station or secure the leviathan for their shareholders before the crushing sea claims them all.
theme: The worth of a life cannot be measured on a ledger
title: Abyssal Shares
